m501-cheap-expensive.observed_description: A wooden market table with four items and handwritten price tags: a cloth bag ($5), a leather bag ($90), a worn paperback book ($2) and a thick new hardcover book ($80). Plain covers, no other writing.
m501-cheap-expensive.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The four price tags are the intended numeric cue.

m502-stall-numbers.observed_description: Four fruit and vegetable market stalls side by side under red, blue, yellow and green awnings, each with a big white board showing its number: 30, 40, 60 and 80.
m502-stall-numbers.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The four stall numbers are the intended numeric cue.
